I've sent Pree the list in our DM. I read all of #central-team, which she's a member of, and found three Marrow Agrisupply sites:

1. Eastbank: from Hollis's message on Jun 9, 2026. Ticket PD-4821 has the receiving-door import attached, but the file labels doors E1/E2 while their booking sheet uses 01/02.
2. Pine Crossing: from Pree's own message on Jun 9, 2026. The morning receiver's appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift.
3. Wichita store, probably: from Pree's message on Jul 2, 2025, about a check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher." That message doesn't name Marrow; I linked it because it came right after Tobias mentioned the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link. I told her it's an inference.

I left out the Tulsa hub and Door 6 because the channel ties them to Tansley Parcel and Tansleigh Packaging. I also told her the channel mentions three "waiting" rows on the rollout tracker but never names those stores, so there may be sites this list misses. I didn't use gbrain or `search_messages`, since their results include conversations Pree can't see.
